description: This file is a PHP-based web page used for adding a blocked service in a content control or parental control system. It includes server-side PHP code for configuration and permission checks, as well as client-side JavaScript and HTML for rendering a form that allows users to specify service parameters, blocked times, and days.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: External function used to fetch the current setting of a configuration parameter, specifically 'Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Enable' in this context.
